newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul won ends lower pressured by dollar/yen.
newsitem.headline: Seoul won ends lower pressured by dollar/yen.

text.p: The South Korean won slipped lower on Tuesday in line with the yen's weakness despite the central bank's efforts to slow the local unit's fall, traders said.
The dollar's continued strength against the Japanese yen on world markets was a difficult weight to shake off, they said.
The won closed at 852.80, down from an opening of 850.80.
"The Bank of Korea came out this afternoon, but not very aggressively as it seems to have resigned itself to the won's decline," said a local bank dealer.
"Without support, the won will keep falling."
